verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single mention that customers must be linked to at least one account 'via Connect,' which points to a first-party account-linking flow. Nothing describes it as a hosted or drop-in widget, how a session is created server-side, or what comes back after linking. The token docs cover partner API authentication (Partner ID, secret, appKey), not a token for the connected account. Missing for 10: documentation of server-side Connect session/URL generation, an embeddable or hosted widget SDK, the callback or token returned for the linked account, confirmation that no institution UI must be built, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
